nodes.summary: For finite types $\iota$ and $F$, a word $x : \iota \to F$ and a natural number $e$, the closed Hamming ball of radius $e$ about $x$ is the finite set of all words $y : \iota \to F$ whose Hamming distance from $x$ is at most $e$.
nodes.title: Closed Hamming ball

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $F$ be a finite alphabet with $q \ge 2$ letters. For every word $x \in F^n$ and every natural number $e$, the closed Hamming ball of radius $e$ about $x$ has $\sum_{k=0}^{e} \binom{n}{k} (q - 1)^k$ elements.
nodes.title: Size of a Hamming ball of fixed-length words

nodes.summary: For finite types $\iota$ and $F$, every word $x : \iota \to F$ and every natural number $e$, the closed Hamming ball of radius $e$ about $x$ has $\sum_{k=0}^{e} \binom{|\iota|}{k} (|F| - 1)^k$ elements.
nodes.title: Size of a Hamming ball

nodes.title: Hamming bound

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a nonempty finite alphabet with $q$ letters, and let $n$ and $d$ be natural numbers with $1 \le d \le n$. If $C$ is a set of words of length $n$ over $\alpha$ in which any two distinct words are at Hamming distance at least $d$, then $C$ has at most $q^{n - d + 1}$ elements.
nodes.title: Singleton bound

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
